description: This file defines a React component named AgentsChart that displays a bar chart of LLM cost distribution by agent. It fetches data from a backend API, handles loading and error states, formats currency values, and renders a responsive chart with styling. The component uses external UI components like Card, LoadingState, and ErrorState, as well as utility functions for API calls and theme styling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches agent cost data from the backend API, normalizes and sorts it, then updates the component state.

methods.name: numberToUsdShort
methods.description: Formats a number into abbreviated USD currency string, e.g., $1.2K.

methods.name: numberToUsdFull
methods.description: Formats a number into full USD currency string with up to 6 decimal places.
